title: McFerrin Park Hideaway
description:
Newly remodeled and furnished home less than 10 minutes from downtown. Neighborhood features great restaurants within a couple of blocks and family friendly McFerrin Park. Our home features great common spaces in an open floorplan along with outdoor space. Living room with a large sectional couch, newly remodeled kitchen with brand new appliances and center island. Three bedrooms featuring king bed, queen bed and bunk beds (full and twin) with two bathrooms.

The space
Newly remodeled and furnished home less than 10 minutes from downtown, Germantown, and new Titans stadium. The neighborhood is notable for having great restaurants and there are several that are only a couple of blocks away (Fancypants, June, Xiao Bao, Folk, Redheaded Stranger, and Dukos). A few blocks away is McFerrin Park that has tennis courts, playground, and a community center.

From the curb you will notice the front porch with a couple of rocking chairs perfect for enjoying the beautiful weather in Nashville. The front door includes a combination smart lock for easy access into our home during your stay.

Step into our home which features an open concept, refinished hardwood floors, and new lighting fixtures. The living room has a large sectional couch perfect for enjoying a movie on the large TV or catching up with family and friends. From there, you will see our newly remodeled kitchen featuring white shaker cabinets, GE stainless steel appliances, a large island, quartz countertops and a tile backsplash.

On the opposite wall, is a bar cart with bar tools to make the perfect drink. Situated next to the bar cart is more cabinets and a coffee bar stocked with many different flavors of coffee. We have both a Keurig and a coffee pot. In case you need a comfortable spot to work, there is also a new desk and chair next to the coffee area. Adjacent to the kitchen and the desk is a comfortable dining table that seats six and a wine storage table (sorry no wine kept in there for guests unless negotiated prior to stay).

Our home includes three fully furnished and decorated bedrooms along with two bathrooms. The first bedroom includes bunk beds (brand new full and twin mattresses), a chair and side tables, as well as a dresser and closet. The second bedroom has a lovely queen bed, bookshelf, mirror, small dresser, and a closet with plenty of room. These two bedrooms look onto the front yard and share a full bathroom that includes a bath tub with a shower, sink and toilet.

Our primary suite is centered around a brand new comfortable king mattress, dresser, TV and trunk with extra blankets. The primary suite also has two closets and its own three piece bathroom which has a walk-in shower, toilet, and sink. Above the sink, there is a mirror with extra bright built-in lighting for those that want to get their makeup just right.

At the back of the house is a sunroom featuring a very comfortable brand new couch, a game table and a TV. The game table is perfect for kids or competitive adults and includes foosball, air hockey, pool (mini), and ping pong (mini). Adjacent to the sunroom is a dedicated laundry and storage room. Here you will find brand new washer and dryer along with detergent, dryer sheets, iron and ironing pad.

Our home also has a large backyard with a privacy fence so our guests can enjoy lawn games or eat outside at our outdoor dining area. The outdoor dining area includes a table for 6 next to a new propane grill.

Additional items to notes:
Two of the three bedrooms have ceiling fans along with the living room,
Spare sheets and towels are available for guests,
Plenty of dishes, glasses and silverware so you won't have to run the dishwasher after every meal,
Sorry no pets.
No smoking or vaping inside of the house. $500 cleaning fee will be assessed if evidence of smoking inside the house is found.
For security purposes, there are cameras on the exterior of the house so that each entrance can be seen, along with a security system. We will consider turning off the security system if you request it.
We love our neighborhood, which is very diverse. If you don't appreciate a diverse neighborhood please don't rent our home.

Guest access
Prior to arrival, guest will be provided with a code to open the front door. Press on the keypad to activate it, enter your code and then press the check mark on the lower right hand corner of the keypad.

The security system will be turned off before your arrival.

Other things to note
No more than 6 people on the property at any time and no parties. Strictly enforced.
